quote_json: "within any initializing expression within its declarator"
requirement: A local variable cannot be referenced by name inside an initializing expression of its own declarator.
retirement_reason: Subclause 7.7.1 explicitly permits assignment to an explicitly typed local in its own initializer. An unassigned read remains forbidden by 9.4 and 13.6.2.1; 13.6.2.2 separately forbids self-reference for an implicitly typed local.
